verdict.rationale: Goodwin's venture capital practice page says it represents both sides of venture deals: over 1,200 emerging companies and entrepreneurs, plus 200 venture capital and private equity firms. A VC fund formation team handling funds from under $25M to over $10B backs up the investor side. The claim that this gives the firm current market-terms knowledge is implied rather than shown, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: a market-terms publication or deal-terms survey showing current market knowledge, independent corroboration of the two-sided practice.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm also represents venture funds and investors, so it knows current market terms from both sides of the table

citations.quote: providing dedicated representation to over 1,200 emerging companies and entrepreneurs and 200 venture capital and private equity firms
Our VC Fund Formation attorneys help clients raise domestic and international funds ranging from less than $25 million to over $10 billion.
